findings: Whole error module read: fatal/warning dispatch, bounded diagnostic formatting, benign/app/chunk severity, jump-buffer setup/free, default handlers and simplified safe execution.

Fatal callback returning falls through to default error; png_longjmp uses registered function/buffer, otherwise PNG_ABORT. Warning behavior differs and can continue. No process-abort or failure injection executed.
jmp_buf allocation supports local or heap buffer, size-change rejected; cleanup temporarily installs local jump target while freeing heap jump state.
Simplified png_safe_execute restores previous error buffer on success/failure and frees image on outermost failure; this is not automatic ownership of arbitrary malloc buffers held by legacy callers.

libphash PNG backend uses setjmp and external output/row-pointer malloc. Existing source observation of potentially skipped frees needs dedicated valid-small failure-path test when resource window permits.
No production code copied/changed, no new build/test or nativepHash.org/ASAN.
